title: Exotic Earthy Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and aromatic Algerian dish featuring tender lamb and a blend of spices, cooked to perfection in a fondue pot. This recipe serves 6 people and is a great option for a special occasion.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the fondue pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the chilli flakes, ground cumin, and smoked paprika and stir to combine.
Add the dried apricots and chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1.5 hours.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
